privacyNotice.title: Privacy notice
privacyNotice.intro: This notice explains how we process personal data when you use the 4rest app, in line with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacyNotice.purposesBody: We process your data to provide your user account, enable app features (e.g. gameplay, points, tasks), and contact you by email when needed (e.g. verification, password reset).
privacyNotice.dataBody: This includes in particular: email address, password (stored as a secure hash), the name you provide, and usage and points data generated in the app.
privacyNotice.legalBody: Processing is based on performing the contract for using the app (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and, where applicable, legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR), e.g. operating the service securely. Where you give consent, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR applies.
privacyNotice.rightsBody: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and to object to certain processing. You may also lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. You may withdraw consent at any time with effect for the future.
privacyNotice.contactBody: For privacy questions or to exercise your rights, please use the contact details given in the imprint or in the app (e.g. support email).
